title: gitwise repository policy
description: Contents of .gitwise/policy.json, the declarative policy gitwise enforces at commit and push time.

version.description: policy schema version; gitwise refuses any other value

protected_branches.description: branches protected against history rewrites: force pushes and deletions (direct commits are governed by block_direct_commits)

forbidden_paths.description: fnmatch patterns; a staged path matching any of them blocks the commit

require_gpg.description: block commits when GPG signing is not configured and ready

block_secrets.description: block on high-severity secret findings; when false they are reported as warnings

allow_force_push.description: allow non-fast-forward pushes to protected branches

block_direct_commits.description: block commits made directly on a protected branch
